title: 信息日报 2026-10-05

headline.title: 科学家利用“真空”让超导体更强
headline.summary: 研究人员证明，看似空无一物的真空中量子涨落可增强超导性，使一种超薄材料的超导转变温度提升最高5.4%。该发现意味着或可通过工程化真空环境，在不直接接触或外部驱动的情况下调控量子材料。
headline.title_en: Scientists just made a superconductor stronger using “empty space”
headline.summary_en: Researchers have demonstrated that quantum fluctuations in supposedly empty space can strengthen superconductivity, raising the transition temperature of an ultrathin material by as much as 5.4%. The discovery opens the possibility of using specially engineered vacuum environments to control quantum materials without direct contact or external driving.
headline.original_title: Scientists just made a superconductor stronger using “empty space”
headline.reason: 该研究综合评分最高，展示量子材料调控的新路径，可能影响超导与量子器件未来方向。
headline.reason_en: Top-scored item; it demonstrates a new route to control quantum materials and could influence future superconductivity and quantum device research.
